title: Geometric Ext presentations for the Mayer--Vietoris base-change comparison
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure on S, f:X→Spec R a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], M an O_X-module, and U,V opens with U union V=X. Use [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] for F (the underlying abelian sheaf of M), G (exact abelian inverse image along the cartesian projection X_S→X), N (the underlying abelian sheaf of the pulled-back module), φ:G(F)→N (the adjoint coefficient map), and the scalar representations ρ:R→End(F), τ:S→End(N). Put A_X(n)=HOver f M n, A(W,n)=HOver (W.ι≫f) (pullback W.ι M) n and B_X(n),B(W,n) the corresponding base-changed groups. There exists a short exact short complex K of abelian sheaves on X and additive equivalences e_X:A_X(n)≃Ext(K.X₃,F,n), e_P:A(U,n)×A(V,n)≃Ext(K.X₂,F,n), e_I:A(U intersection V,n)≃Ext(K.X₁,F,n). There are likewise additive equivalences e'_X,e'_P,e'_I from the corresponding B groups to Ext((G K).X₃,N,n), Ext((G K).X₂,N,n), Ext((G K).X₁,N,n). For e_X,e_P,e_I, e(a x)=e(x) composed with mk₀(ρ(a)), and for e'_X,e'_P,e'_I, e'(s x)=e'(x) composed with mk₀(τ(s)). If b_X and b_W are exactly H.baseChangeLinear, then e'_X(b_X x)=G(e_X x) composed with mk₀(φ), e'_P(b_U x,b_V y)=G(e_P(x,y)) composed with mk₀(φ), and e'_I(b_{U intersection V} z)=G(e_I z) composed with mk₀(φ). No horizontal maps, exactness of the cohomology rows, or compatibility of boundaries is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Construct the actual signed free-sheaf short complex and apply its short exactness theorem. Apply the single-term global comparison and the open comparison to U, V and their intersection. Combine the U,V additive equivalences using Ext.biprodAddEquiv and the explicit mapped biproduct equivalence. Scalar compatibility follows from Ext.add_comp and comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero. The product comparison follows from exact-functor preservation of addition and composition and the same associativity identity. Assemble the two ExtRowPresentation structures and the three vertical identities.

theorem H.exists_mayerVietoris_extPresentation
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules)
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M
    let G := invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) f)
    let N := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)
    let φ := coeff (baseChangeFst (S := S) f) (baseChangeUnit (S := S) f M)
    let ρ := (scalarRep M).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom)
    let τ := (scalarRep (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f).appTop).hom)
    let A := fun (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) ↦
      HOver (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M) n
    let B := fun (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) ↦
      HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f))
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M)) n
    let AX := fun n : ℕ ↦ HOver f M n
    let BX := fun n : ℕ ↦
      HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f) (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M) n
    ∃ (K : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
      (_hK : K.ShortExact)
      (E : H.ExtRowPresentation R K F ρ AX
        (fun n ↦ A U n × A V n) (fun n ↦ A (U ⊓ V) n))
      (E' : H.ExtRowPresentation S (K.map G) N τ BX
        (fun n ↦ B U n × B V n) (fun n ↦ B (U ⊓ V) n)),
      (∀ n x, E'.eX n (H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) f M n x) =
        ((E.eX n x).mapExactFunctor G).comp (Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n (x : A U n × A V n), E'.eP n
        (H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) (U.ι ≫ f) ((pullback U.ι).obj M) n x.1,
         H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) (V.ι ≫ f) ((pullback V.ι).obj M) n x.2) =
        ((E.eP n x).mapExactFunctor G).comp (Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, E'.eI n
        (H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ f) ((pullback (U ⊓ V).ι).obj M) n x) =
        ((E.eI n x).mapExactFunctor G).comp (Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n))
